hero.lead: We design and engineer complete digital systems that generate leads, build authority, and create long-term growth.
hero.summaryHtml: Cozelos Data is a Woman-Owned digital agency in Vernal, Utah building custom websites, SEO, video, and marketing for local and government businesses. Custom projects start at {websiteStartingPrice}, load in under a second, and you own everything — the domain, code, and content.

problem.line1: Every day, potential customers search for businesses like yours.
line2: Some never find you at all.
problem.bodyHtml: Your online presence should be your hardest-working employee — earning trust, generating leads, and creating opportunities 24 hours a day. That’s why we build digital systems, not just websites.

whyDifferent.title: The difference is night and day.

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.headlineHtml: We don’t simply build websites — we build digital assets that grow businesses.
mission.tagline: Making businesses stronger. Making life better.
mission.body: A website is an expense. A growth platform is an investment — one that earns leads, authority, and revenue for years. We don’t build pages that sit online. We build systems that go to work for your business every day.

quoteBlock.caption: Technology simply makes great strategy scalable.

philosophy.title: Four convictions behind every build.
philosophy.lead: Great digital work isn't a pile of features. It's a sequence — each layer earning the next.

pillars.title: Beautiful design earns attention.
pillars.body: First impressions happen in milliseconds. Cinematic, intentional design earns the trust to keep someone reading.

pillars.title: Performance keeps visitors engaged.
pillars.body: Speed is respect. Sub-second loads and seamless motion hold attention instead of testing patience.

pillars.title: SEO brings customers.
pillars.body: Visibility is the difference between a brochure and a pipeline. We build to be found by the people already searching for you.

pillars.title: Strategy turns customers into growth.
pillars.body: Design, speed, and search only matter when aimed at outcomes. Every decision ladders up to revenue.

whyChooseUs.title: Why ambitious businesses choose us.
whyChooseUs.lead: A website is a cost. A growth platform is a competitive advantage. Here's what sets ours apart.

reasons.title: Systems, not pages
reasons.body: We connect design, SEO, marketing, and automation into one system engineered to compound — not a disconnected set of deliverables.

reasons.title: Engineered for speed
reasons.body: Sub-second load times, built by hand. Faster sites rank higher, convert more, and respect every visitor's time.

reasons.title: Built to be found
reasons.body: SEO and AI-search architecture are baked in from day one, so the right customers find you the moment they're looking.

reasons.title: You own everything
reasons.body: Your domain, your code, your content. No proprietary lock-ins, no hostage retainers — just assets that belong to you.

reasons.title: Measured by results
reasons.body: We report on the outcomes that matter — leads, rankings, and revenue — not vanity metrics that only look good on a slide.

reasons.title: A long-term partner
reasons.body: Every milestone documented, every site monitored and improving. We stay invested long after launch day.

founder.title: Meet Ellen Cozelos.
founder.bodyHtml: More than 20 years supporting NASA, Department of Defense programs, and commercial organizations — now bringing that same enterprise standard to businesses like yours. The kind of partner who treats your success as the whole point.

card.name: Ellen Cozelos
card.imageAlt: Cozelos Data — founded by Ellen Cozelos in Vernal, Utah

services.title: Six disciplines. One growth system.
services.lead: Six services, one connected system. Each one makes the others work harder — and your business grow faster.

whoWeWorkWith.title: Built for businesses that take their work seriously.
whoWeWorkWith.lead: Your industry has its own customers, language, and competition. These are the businesses we help win online every day.

process.title: A proven path from idea to growth.
process.lead: No mystery, no surprises. A clear path from first call to lasting growth.

steps.title: Discovery & Strategy
steps.body: We start with your business — goals, customers, and the outcomes that define success. Strategy before pixels.

steps.title: Design & Architecture
steps.body: Cinematic design meets SEO architecture. We map every page, message, and conversion path before a line of code.

steps.title: Build & Engineer
steps.body: Hand-built for speed, security, and scale. No bloated templates — just clean, fast, custom engineering.

steps.title: Launch & Optimize
steps.body: We go live with analytics, search indexing, and performance dialed in — then watch the data and refine.

steps.title: Grow & Support
steps.body: The asset goes to work. Ongoing SEO, content, and maintenance keep it ranking, converting, and improving.

results.title: Stronger businesses, by every measure.
results.lead: You don't buy a website. You buy outcomes — the kind that show up in your rankings, your leads, and your bottom line.

portfolio.title: Real businesses. Measurable growth.
portfolio.lead: Utah businesses we moved from invisible to in-demand. See the full stories in the portfolio.
